description: Describe a job in plain words and it gets done in ONE paid call: picks the right tools from 71 capabilities - transcription, translation, documents, images, web, on-chain, domains, IPs, weather, FX - fills their parameters and chains up to 3 steps, feeding each result into the next. Priced per job: the 402 challenge quotes YOUR job before you sign, from $0.02. You pay for not having to know which tool or which order. If nothing fits, nothing is charged. $0.02 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

input.description: Optional data the job needs: a URL, an EVM address, a domain, or text.

job.description: The job to do, in plain words. Example: read this page and translate it to Spanish.

max_steps.description: How many tools may be chained, 1 to 3. Default 2.

name: do
title: Describe the job, get it done: one call over the whole toolbox
